summary: Use four legend icons on the left to construct a large sprite by combining unit sprite with frame shape, then place it on background at position and rotation indicated by position marker and rotation marker.
src: unit sprite pattern from legend row 1 s1
dst: each foreground pixel position in frame shape from legend row 2 d1
match_cond: s1 replaces each pixel of d1.frame to create enlarged composite sprite
transform: tile s1 at each d1.pixel position to form fractal-like enlarged sprite
symbol_instructions: legend row 1: unit sprite pattern; legend row 2: frame shape template; legend row 3: position marker (pixel location in small square indicates anchor on background); legend row 4: rotation indicator (clock-hand style determines rotation angle)
multi_step: Step 1: read four legend icons from left column; Step 2: construct enlarged sprite by tiling unit sprite into frame shape; Step 3: determine placement position from position marker; Step 4: determine rotation from rotation marker; Step 5: place rotated enlarged sprite at indicated position on background
dst2: position on main background grid d2
match_cond2: s2.anchor == position indicated by marker pixel in legend row 3 square; s2.rotation == rotation indicated by clock-hand marker in legend row 4
transform2: rotate(s2, angle from legend row 4) then place at d2
